subject: general
question: In which country did Manushi Chhillar win the Miss World 2017 title?
solution:
The correct option is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Manushi Chhillar is an Indian actress and model.

 
 
• She won the Miss World 2017 pageant.
 
• She is from Haryana, India.
 
• Miss World 2017 was held in China.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Miss World 2020 is Toni-Ann Singh of Jamaica.
 
• Miss Universe 2020 is Andrea Meza of Mexico.
 
• Mr. World 2020 won by Dhruba Tamuly from Assam.
